title: Query string
skill: State the parsing edge cases up front

good: Rewrite parseQuery(str) in src/query.js. Rules: 1) strip one leading "?"; 2) split on "&" and skip empty pieces; 3) key = text before the first "=", value = everything after it ("x=a=b" gives "a=b"); 4) skip a piece with an empty key ("=1"); 5) a piece without "=" gives true, "a=" gives ""; 6) replace "+" with a space in keys and values, before decoding; 7) then decodeURIComponent keys and values, and if that throws keep the text after step 6; 8) a repeated key gives an array of its values in order ("tag&tag=x" gives [true, "x"]), a key seen once keeps a plain value; 9) "" and "?" give {}. Do not change other files. Then run: node --test test/*.test.js
lazy: parseQuery is too simple. Make it handle real query strings.
